units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 4:1:4">Y. Kil. IV, 29ᵇ</cite> top (in Chald. dict.) <he>ע״י ע׳ תרתיי וכ׳</he> owing to the curvature (of the garden bed) two rows of vines disappear (become indiscernible).

senses.gloss: עֲקִימַת פה or ע׳ שפתים curving the mouth (the lips), speaking sulkily, mumbling, in gen. talk, opp. to מעשה action.
units: <cite ref="Meilah 17b">Meïl. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>מֵעֲ׳ שפתיך וכ׳</he> from the argument thou didst utter in an undertone one can tell that thou art a scholar.
<cite ref="Ketubot 45b:4">Keth. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>ע׳ שפתיו גרמה לו</he> (not <he>גרמו</he>) his talk (casting suspicion on his wife) brought it (the punishment) upon him.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 65a:10">Snh. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ שפתיו הוי מעשה</he> talk (e.g. blasphemy, false testimony) is considered an action (can be punished), <cite ref="Sanhedrin 65b">Ib.ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 90b">B. Mets. 90ᵇ</cite> (in reference to guiding an animal by means of a human voice).
